title: Kth Smallest Element in a Sorted Matrix
description: Given an `n x n` matrix where each of the rows and columns is sorted in ascending order, return the `k`th smallest element in the matrix.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `k`. Following `n` lines contain `n` integers.
hints: Push the first element of each row into a min-heap.
Pop the minimum element k times.
Whenever popping (val, r, c), push the next column element in the same row `(matrix[r][c+1], r, c+1)`.

reference_solution:
import sys, heapq
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    matrix = []
    idx = 2
    for _ in range(n):
        matrix.append([int(x) for x in data[idx:idx+n]])
        idx += n
    pq = [(matrix[i][0], i, 0) for i in range(min(n, k))]
    heapq.heapify(pq)
    ans = 0
    for _ in range(k):
        ans, r, c = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if c + 1 < n: heapq.heappush(pq, (matrix[r][c+1], r, c+1))
    print(ans)
